Neapolitan and Italian: speak like a modern Southern Italian!
pro_course_detail.description:
This Learning Path is suitable for those who already have an Intermediate level of Italian and is designed to help you improve your Italian and simultaneously learn Neapolitan. We will set a customized strategy according to your individual characteristics and needs. 

Specifically, I will help you:

-	Improve you Italian, by focusing on upper intermediate/advanced grammar concepts, vocabulary and idioms;
-	Learn the fundamentals and advanced structures of Neapolitan language;
-	Learn how to mix Italian and Neapolitan languages in daily conversations, like modern Southern Italians do.

Neapolitan is a Romance language spoken across much of Southern Italy and, despite what one may think, It has specific syntactic and grammar rules to form sentences. It is a local dialect, so it is mainly a spoken language, and has had an international impact for many reasons.
I always provide my students with plenty of examples, audiovisual resources and exercise to ensure the concepts are clearly understood.
